directories.src/main/java/net/legendofwar/firecord/c: Contains 6 module files (BungeeSender.java, CliSender.java, SpigotSender.java, FirecordCommand.java)

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/firecord/F.summary: `Firecord` serves as the core entry point for the application, providing overloaded `init` methods to initialize node identity, types, and resources.

deploy.sh.summary: `deploy.sh` automates the Maven build process and deploys compiled Minecraft plugin JARs to local or remote server directories. It serves as the project's deployment script.

README.md.summary: `README.md` documents Firecord, a virtual distributed object memory system using Redis and AspectJ. It serves as the project's primary overview and comparison guide.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/firecord/c.summary: `BungeeSender` implements the `Sender` interface to wrap BungeeCord's `CommandSender`. It bridges platform-agnostic commands to the BungeeCord proxy environment.

`CliSender` implements the `Sender` interface to output messages to the command line, translating Minecraft color codes into ANSI escape sequences. It serves as a CLI-based message handler for the command system.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/firecord/b.summary: `FirecordBungee` initializes Firecord as a BungeeCord node in `onEnable`, registers the `/firecord` command, and shuts Firecord down in `onDisable`. It serves as the BungeeCord plugin entry point.

src/main/java/net/legendofwar/firecord/c.summary: `SpigotSender` implements the `Sender` interface to wrap Bukkit's `CommandSender`. It bridges command execution for Spigot platforms within the project.
This file provides test data generators and lookup tables for development tasks. It exports `FirecordCommand` to configure and execute Redis integration tests within the project.
`Sender` is an interface that defines the `sendMessage(String)` method for dispatching text responses. It acts as an abstraction layer for command executors across the project.

`ByteMessage` defines message types for serializing and deserializing data types from a `ByteBuffer`. Its primary method, `read()`, parses bytes into corresponding Java objects, facilitating network communication.
`CommunicationTests` provides test utilities for verifying Jedis-based messaging. It exports `init()` and `sendMessage()` to validate pub-sub communication within the project.

`VelocitySender` wraps Velocity's `CommandSource` to implement the project's `Sender` interface. It bridges command execution by enabling string-based message delivery to Velocity players or consoles.
